messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: High 5xx error rate detected on ingress-proxy cluster (prod). 502/504 spike starting ~2755559800. See runbook: https://interna.l/runbooks/ingress-5xx-hotline

SRE-Oncall: on it. taking lead. Investigating metrics and recent deploys.

Meera K: seeing a big jump for /v1/generate and auth callback endpoints, 502 rate ~18% across US regions, EU ~3%. latency on upstream connections also spiking.

Casey L: any recent infra deploys? I see a config push to envoy-proxy at 2755559000.

SRE-Oncall: good call. pulling deploy logs. @Casey L can you paste the envoy diff?

Casey L: pasted partial diff: ```
- cluster: upstream-gen
- connect_timeout: 2s
+ connect_timeout: 500ms
```

Jamal: oof, that 500ms change could cause frankentimeouts if upstream bursts. Could explain 504s.

SRE-Oncall: running quick check of upstream health: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=generator -o wide` shows all pods Ready but increased restart count on gen-2 instances. tailing logs.

OpsBot: alert: backend-generator pod gen-2-7 crashed at 2755559952 -> OOMKilled (memory pressure).

Meera K: looks like a feedback loop: envoy cut connect timeout -> more upstream backlog -> pod OOMs -> more 502s.

SRE-Oncall: mitigation plan: 1) revert envoy connect_timeout to 2s, 2) scale generator replicas + enable circuit breaker, 3) enable temporary route fallback to backup-gen pool, 4) notify product + customers. Executing now.

SRE-Oncall: rolling config revert. command: ```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-config -p '{"data":{"connect_timeout":"2s"}}' && kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/envoy-proxy
```

Casey L: rolling restart started. watch logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=envoy-proxy --tail 100 -f`

Meera K: scaling generator now: ```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/generator --replicas=10
```

OpsBot: autoscaler notice: added 4 replicas for deployment/generator.

SRE-Oncall: enabling route fallback to backup-gen: patched virtualservice to prefer backup pool at 30% for now.

Liz Product: flagging customers via status page. Impacted endpoints: /v1/generate, /auth/callback. Estimating ~12% of traffic affected across US during peak. Posting status update.

Jamal: also enabling a temporary 429-based rate limiter on large clients to reduce fanout: applying policy to heavy-key clients.

SRE-Oncall: observing metric shift: 502 rate dropping from 18% -> 6% in us-west after revert and scale. EU stable. continuing to monitor.

Casey L: envoy pods back to healthy with old timeout. No config drift detected.

SRE-Oncall: confirming pod restarts trending down and OOM events stopped. Continuing 10m monitoring window.

Meera K: running synthetic requests to /v1/generate — 200s returned, latency acceptable (~180ms).

OpsBot: note: throttles applied to 4 heavy API keys.

Liz Product: pushed status page update: "Mitigated: Ingress errors reduced after rollback and scaling. Monitoring."

SRE-Oncall: planning handoff to night oncall in 20m. Will keep escalation channel open. Anyone object to keeping fallback at 30% for another hour?

Jamal: fine with that. keep rate limits for heavy keys in place.

Casey L: recommend follow-up: add pre-deploy test that validates connect_timeout doesn't drop below 1s for generator route and add memory headroom checks for generator pods.

Meera K: creating post-incident ticket with timeframe, root cause (envoy timeout regression + upstream memory pressure), mitigation steps, and customer impact numbers.

SRE-Oncall: summary (to be used in incident notes): "Root cause: a config change reduced envoy connect_timeout to 500ms causing upstream request failures during burst -> increased backlog and pod OOMs -> elevated 502/504. Mitigation: reverted timeout, scaled generator replicas, enabled fallback routing and temporary rate limiting; errors fell from ~18% to ~2-6% across regions. Next steps: tighter deploy guardrails, pre-deploy perf tests, add circuit breaker defaults." :thumbsup:

OpsBot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-134.

SRE-Oncall: handing off to night-oncall @SRE-Oncall-Night. please monitor 15m, then close if stable. Leaving logs and commands in the runbook thread.

SRE-Oncall: :white_check_mark: Resolved after sustained stability window at 2755560299. Closing thread in 10m unless regressions.
